content.title: When AI cuts implementation labour, who gets the saving?
content.thesis: The labour saving changes price, margin or scope only when the commercial mechanism lets it through.
content.approved_text: Longer autonomous runs can mean fewer interventions and less delivery labour. Buyers still pay for risk and accountability, so the saving may never reach the invoice.
content.audience: Enterprise leaders need to know who captures the saving.
content.intended_payoff: A way to inspect whether AI changes price, margin or scope.

claims.text: The labour saving changes price, margin or scope only when the commercial mechanism lets it through.
